comparison.objective: Candidate finishes inserts through tang fracture; record performs manual blood-pressure measurement on a training arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses aligned impact tooling and fragment recovery; record coordinates cuff pumping, controlled bleed-down, stethoscope placement, and pressure/auditory monitoring.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four contained fractures without equipment damage; record requires pressure above 160 mmHg, continuous listening while descending past 100 mmHg at 2–4 mmHg/s, full deflation, and release.
comparison.reason: Timed pneumatic measurement and sensing test a different ability from impact fracture and retention-sensitive manipulation.
